say:1:1223608001:1.text: Besides, the roof of our place is leaking again. With the typhoon coming soon, I'm a total basket case now.
say:1:1223608001:1.source_cn: 唉……我们住的那个屋子又漏水了，眼看台风快来了，真愁。
say:1:1223608001:1.male: Besides, the roof of our place is leaking again. With the typhoon coming soon, I'm a total basket case now.
say:1:1223608001:1.female: Besides, the roof of our place is leaking again. With the typhoon coming soon, I'm a total basket case now.

say:2:1223608002:1.text: We can't afford to hire professionals, so I wanted to fix it myself. Yet, I don't even have enough materials...
say:2:1223608002:1.source_cn: 专业的工匠请不起，我想着自己来补，但是原料都凑不齐……
say:2:1223608002:1.male: We can't afford to hire professionals, so I wanted to fix it myself. Yet, I don't even have enough materials...
say:2:1223608002:1.female: We can't afford to hire professionals, so I wanted to fix it myself. Yet, I don't even have enough materials...

say:3:1223608003:1.text: If you don't mind, could you gather some <style="stress">wood</style> and <style="stress">mud</style> for me? You're the only one here who's willing to help us.
say:3:1223608003:1.source_cn: 方便的话，帮我找些<style=stress>木材</...
say:3:1223608003:1.male: If you don't mind, could you gather some <style="stress">wood</style> and <style="stress">mud</style> for me? You're the only one here who's willing to help us.
say:3:1223608003:1.female: If you don't mind, could you gather some <style="stress">wood</style> and <style="stress">mud</style> for me? You're the only one here who's willing to help us.

say:0:1223609001:0.text: There's plenty of wood here at the <style="stress">Lumberyard</style>!

say:0:1223610001:0.text: This much wood should be enough!

say:1:1223610002:0.text: We still need some <style="stress">mud</style>. How about we check out the <style="stress">Eroded Tunnel</style>?

say:0:1223611001:0.text: Eww... What a disgusting creature. We'd better take off.
say:0:1223611001:0.source_cn: 呃……好恶心的生物，我们快离开这里吧。

say:1:1223612001:1.text: Nice! We've got all the materials now!
say:1:1223612001:1.male: Nice! We've got all the materials now!
say:1:1223612001:1.female: Nice! We've got all the materials now!

say:2:1223612002:1.text: Wanna give it a go, <style="stress"><player_name></style>? I hear it's similar to preparing a potion.

document:3:85:0.text: An aromatic concoction that emits a pungent scent, expertly blended from <style="stress">wood and mud</style>. Can be used to repair damaged walls.
document:3:85:0.source_cn: 散发着刺鼻味道的浆体，由<style="stress">木材和泥浆</style>调配而成，可以修补破损的墙面。

say:1:1223613001:1.text: That's it! Now that the roof is fixed, we don't have to sweat about the typhoon. Thanks a lot!
say:1:1223613001:1.source_cn: 足够了足够了，补好屋顶，再也不用担心台风会把家当给卷走...
